- Tue 6/23: 11:00–11:45 or 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed 6/24: 10:00–10:45 or 15:00–15:45 PT

I’ll loop in our SE (Soojin) once we confirm a time and drop a short agenda + discovery checklist. Attaching a one-pager agenda for reference.

Thanks — Olga
